items.item: RESOLVED during cross-session re-verification: NFL.com's detailed standings tail columns were decoded and validated arithmetically for all 32 teams (HOME+ROAD = W-L-T record; DIV% and CONF% recompute exactly from DIV/CONF). data/standings-2026-reg-w8.json now carries W,L,T,PCT,PF,PA,NET,HOME,ROAD,DIV,DIV%,CONF,CONF%,STRK. Two remaining rendered tail columns (positions 14 and 16) could not be label-verified and are still omitted rather than guessed. An earlier in-session capture had mislabeled positions 8-9 as DIV/CONF; corrected and logged in COORDINATION.md.

Team affiliation is not rendered on NFL.com player-stats leader pages (rushing/receiving/interceptions). The 'team' field is therefore null in data/player-rushing-2026.json, data/player-receiving-2026.json, data/player-interceptions-2026.json, and null for 4 QBs (C.J. Stroud, Brock Purdy, Tyler Shough, Trevor Lawrence) in data/player-passing-2026.json (all other QBs verified against the Next Gen Stats Week 8 table, which renders TEAM). Team can be confirmed on each player's official page (player_url column).

Two trailing columns on the NFL.com receiving leaders page could not be label-verified arithmetically from the capture; they are stored as neutral keys tail_10 / tail_11 in data/player-receiving-2026.json and are NOT shown as labeled stats on the site.

UPDATED 2026-11-04 (session d22c14b9): the official NFL.com Week 9 injury report IS now published (https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg9). Verified for the two model-evaluated games only: CIN at ATL and NYG at PHI, both teams "No Injuries Reported" (data/injuries-2026-week9-candidates.json). The other 13 Week 9 games are not yet transcribed — see F-22.

Market betting lines (spreads/totals) are NOT published by the NFL or any official league source. Values seen on third-party aggregators (nflschedules.com showing 'FanDuel' spreads; an ESPN scoreboard capture showing 'SF -10, Total 48.5') are recorded in data/market-lines.json as UNVERIFIED third-party values. Live lines must be verified at a licensed sportsbook's own site; in the Netherlands only Ksa-licensed providers may be used (check https://kansspelautoriteit.nl/kansspelwijzer). Lines move constantly — treat any captured line as time-stamped and stale. CORRECTION 2026-11-04: because no official market line exists, G6 (edge vs market) is NOT_COMPUTABLE for every Week 9 game; the two previously listed candidates (CIN at ATL, NYG at PHI) were demoted and their market-based edges withheld. See F-23.

Third-party sites disagree with official NFL.com records for some teams as of 2026-11-03 (e.g., an ESPN scoreboard capture showed BAL 4-3, LAC 0-6, SF 6-1 with different W9 slate records; nflschedules.com showed different records again). Official NFL.com standings (https://www.nfl.com/standings/) are treated as authoritative everywhere in this project; all third-party discrepancies are discarded, not averaged.

Model line assumptions (e.g., home-field advantage of 2.5 points, edge threshold of 1.0 point, vig/juice of -110) are ANALYTICAL ASSUMPTIONS of this project, not values from any official source. They are labeled as assumptions wherever used (analysis/model-lines-week9.json, research docs) and are adjustable parameters, not facts.

NFL.com player-stats leader pages paginate; captures contain the top 25 rows per category as rendered (sorted by the chosen stat, desc). Players outside the top 25 are available on the official source pages but were not captured into the JSON to keep the dataset reviewable.

Turnover margin (a common 'luck' metric) requires fumble data, which is not present in the captured team stat categories; only INT-based proxies are computed. Fumble-based luck adjustment is therefore NOT applied — flagged so no one assumes it was.

This project is a research/analytics competition framework. It does not place, facilitate, or intermediate any real-money wager. Leaderboard 'rewards' are points/trophies only. Gambling can be addictive — in the Netherlands only use Ksa-licensed providers (https://kansspelautoriteit.nl/), self-exclude via CRUKS (https://kansspelautoriteit.nl/uitsluitregister-cruks), and in the US call 1-800-GAMBLER (https://www.ncpgambling.org/). Strictly 18+ (NL) / 21+ where required by local law.

Parallel session's capture data/nfl-2026-standings.csv (session 9cf451e4, source nfl.com/standings): its 'div' column actually matches the HOME record column and its 'conf' matches CONF — its div/home labels appear swapped. W,L,T,PCT,PF,PA,NET,streak match this session's JSON on all 32 teams (see analysis/verification.json). The CSV is retained for provenance; use data/standings-2026-reg-w8.json for labeled values.

Eagles QB Jalen Hurts: the nfl.com article headline reads 'likely out for rest of 2026 season', while the body also quotes the Eagles/agent statement that 'we expect a full recovery' with 'no long-term effects' and that the return this season is 'in doubt' (per insider reports). The site uses the article's own 'likely out' wording and does not state a definitive season-ending outcome. Article date 2026-10-19; status not re-confirmed after that date.

Official news items affecting Week 9 (Hurts, McLaurin) are dated 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-21, i.e., more than two weeks before the 2026-11-04 check. The pages were fetched 2026-11-04 and their text is unchanged, but later roster moves (e.g., IR/practice-squad/roster changes) would not be captured in this project's data unless the news feed is re-captured.

Week 9 official injury report: only the two model-evaluated games (CIN at ATL, NYG at PHI) are transcribed. The other 13 Week 9 games (JAX at BAL, DEN at CAR, DAL at IND, NYJ at KC, DET at MIA, CLE at NO, LA at WAS, HOU at LAC, LV at SF, GB at NE, AZ at SEA, TB at CHI, BUF at MIN) remain uncaptured and their G4 gate stays CONDITIONAL.
